name: BMF
description: The drug trafficking drama is inspired by the true story of two brothers who rose from the decaying streets of southwest Detroit in the late 1980s and gave birth to one of the most influential crime families in the country. It revolves around brothers Demetrius "Big Meech" Flenory and Terry "Southwest T" Flenory, who together took their vision beyond the drug trade and into the world of hip-hop. The drama, per Starz, will tell a story about love, family and capitalism in the pursuit of the American dream.

videos.title: See It... Touch It... Obtain It
videos.overview: Meech avoids a street war by moving his crew "The 50 Boyz" to a new location. He and his brother Terry cook up a more potent batch of drugs that creates enough demand to help their family overcome the economic crisis.

videos.title: Rumors
videos.overview: Tensions rise between The 50 Boyz and their rivals, which creates repercussions. Lamar plants misinformation so he can actively step towards the throne.

videos.title: Love All, Trust Few
videos.overview: Meech and Terry set up an undercover operation using a food truck to sell drugs to factory workers, while Detective Lopez investigates a murder at the center of the city's drug war.

videos.title: Heroes
videos.overview: Lamar's reign of terror continues, as he works overtime to shut down "The 50 Boyz" for good.

videos.title: Secrets and Lies
videos.overview: Meech and Terry devise a multi-layered plan to reclaim what is rightfully theirs. Detective Lopez's murder investigation begins to heat up when an account from an eyewitness brings some unexpected information to light

videos.title: Strictly Business
videos.overview: Meech and Terry create a new system for "The 50 Boyz" to operate more efficiently, while a secret within their ranks threatens to tear the crew apart.

videos.title: All In the Family
videos.overview: Blood spills into the streets when Meech devises a plan for revenge, forcing Lamar to seek shelter with someone close, which complicates matters even more.

videos.title: The King of Detroit
videos.overview: In an effort to expand into new territory, Meech discovers a disturbing alliance then hatches a plan to eliminate the threat. Terry is forced to make a life-altering decision.

videos.title: Family Dinner
videos.overview: Meech smuggles drugs from Las Vegas as a test to secure a new plug for BMF, a vicious gangster from the Brewster Projects, K-9. Meanwhile, Terry began his new car-ride business with Charles since he left the drug game.

videos.title: Family Business
videos.overview: Meech focuses on expanding BMF into Cleveland while Terry experiences growing pains as he launches his car-ride business with Charles. Terry learns Meech could be in danger.

videos.title: Devil's Night
videos.overview: Devil’s Night and a drug drought causes chaos and a spike in crime in the city of Detroit. Meech seeks a new supply from K-9 at a bloody cost, while Terry confronts a car service competitor.

videos.title: Runnin' on E
videos.overview: With Meech barely out of the hospital and still bleeding out, Terry assumes command of BMF is strapped for cash, out of product and down to its last men; Terry tries to find a new supply.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: On the run, broke and in search of a new plug, Meech and Terry discover the Black Mecca of Atlanta where they connect with old friends and make new allies in an effort to rebuild their business during the drug drought.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Meech and Terry return to Detroit from Atlanta with a product and a new technique to flood the streets with BMF product. Meech links up with Sterling and the PA Boys to continue his quest to kill Lamar.

videos.title: Both Sides of the Fence
videos.overview: In a risky move that could cost them their lives, Meech and Terry travel to St. Martin to steal K-9's Colombian connect.

videos.title: Push It to the Limit
videos.overview: The Flenory brothers buy a car wash to pack cars after being flushed with product from a new plug. Meech turns dealers into kingmakers while Terry hires new drivers.

videos.title: High Treason
videos.overview: The Flenory brothers travel to Atlanta during Freaknik to set up a new distribution hub for BMF and reconnect with their business associates, Ty Washington and Goldie – yet not everyone survives the road trip.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Meech and Terry finally handle Detective Bryant, Lamar, and B-Mickie before charting the next big step for BMF's expansion, which will change the course of their relationship forever.

videos.title: Detroit vs Everybody
videos.overview: Meech officially relocates to Atlanta in search of expanding BMF. Terry remains in Detroit to maintain the BMF enterprise. Meech learns that the move to Atlanta will be full of pleasant and unpleasant surprises.

videos.title: Magic Makers
videos.overview: Meech focuses on expanding BMF into Atlanta while Terry balances maintaining BMF and his family in Detroit. Terry looks for ways to generate revenue for BMF, and Meech comes through with Colombian connects.

videos.title: Sanctuary
videos.overview: Jack the Rapper Weekend turns into chaos when Meech, Glock, the MKs, and the Red Dogs collide. Meech is determined to foster BMF in Atlanta, starting by purchasing a home with the help of his father.

videos.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
videos.overview: Meech returns to Detroit upon Colombian connect Loco’s request to pick up weight for BMF. The amount of weight is insurmountable for him to handle alone thus he solicits help from Terry and the Detroit team.

videos.title: The Battle of Techwood
videos.overview: Meech and Terry rediscover the Black Mecca of Atlanta. Both brothers learn the process of breaking into the scene in Atlanta will not be as easy when they are met with the old guard who wants to retain.

videos.title: Casualties of War
videos.overview: Meech plans to travel to St. Louis to link up with J-Pusha. He hopes to build business in St. Louis and expand BMF. Terry returns to Detroit to welcome the new addition to the family.

videos.title: Get 'em Home
videos.overview: Meech travels to St. Louis to link up with J-Pusha and his brother Carter to set up business there, and he finds a new love interest with Keeya, yet he also learns the hustle in Detroit and in Atlanta is omnipresent.

videos.title: Code Red
videos.overview: Meech returns to Atlanta to learn that the city and his love now belong to Glock. He is determined to take the city from his competitors, yet he learns to do this in a smart manner.

videos.title: Death Trap
videos.overview: Meech and Terry travel to Miami to meet with a mechanic known as Francois. Despite interference, the brothers are determined to accomplish their American Dream.

videos.title: Prime Time
videos.overview: Meech and Terry return to Atlanta. The brothers plan to expand to St. Louis and other cities with Miami as a hub. Meech and Terry are in for one of their greatest adventures.

videos.title: Graduation Day
videos.overview: With Meech MIA, Terry manages the business independently to keep the cash flowing and finds himself at odds as he seeks to exert more control over BMF.

videos.title: Discovery
videos.overview: Meech and Terry are focused on expanding their business; while Terry looks for a new connection in South Carolina, a new musical artist piques Meech's interest; Detective Bryant continues his pursuit of BMF.

videos.title: Good Faith
videos.overview: Meech and Terry find new inspiration in a rising R&B singer. Together, they plan to launch a new record label, and Terry hatches his own plan to regain control in St. Louis.

videos.title: Power Trippin'
videos.overview: Meech and Terry continue to focus on Stomping Ground Records - and on their full-court press to sign Purdy; in St. Louis, things are getting tense as their business partner creates more rivals than friends.

videos.title: See It, Touch It, Mixtape It
videos.overview: Meech and Terry prepare for the Stomping Ground launch party; Meech has a new love interest, and B-Mickie takes a major step in his relationship; back in Detroit, the Flenory family gets surprising news; Meech considers new partners in St. Louis.

videos.title: Bad Religion
videos.overview: Terry's attempts at gaining ground in St. Louis only result in more conflict, leading Meech to intervene; Lucille and Charles continue to navigate life together following their divorce.

videos.title: Enemy Within
videos.overview: Bryant is hot on the heels of BMF in Atlanta and may hit the jackpot; Meech and Terry's St. Louis problems get bigger; Stomping Ground's first artist, Purdy, deals with an internal struggle after Meech and Terry work to revive her career.

videos.title: Death of Hope
videos.overview: Meech and Terry navigate their relationship challenges while looking to expand the business; Purdy is stuck in the middle of a bidding war, leading to an explosive outcome.

videos.title: Point of No Return
videos.overview: Meech and Terry travel to California, hoping to expand their operations with a new set of partners - but it won't be easy; Bryant now shifts his target to someone else after a major discovery; multiple people have B-Mickie in their crosshairs.

videos.title: Dreams Deferred
videos.overview: Meech and Terry return to Atlanta, where a battle ensues, changing relationships and the business forever
